crossRefs.note: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man…
As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you…
Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So…
That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows…
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

translations.web: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
translations.bsb: Night and day he sleeps and wakes, and the seed sprouts and grows, though he knows not how.
translations.kjv: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
translations.asv: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, he knoweth not how.
